senses.whyCN: 这项技术离不开硬件，于是这个词也顺带指那台机器，就像 scanner 指扫描仪一样，工具名常被直接借用。

senses.title: A medical examination
senses.definition: a medical test in which a doctor uses high-frequency sound to look at organs, tissues, or a developing baby
senses.definitionCN: 医生用高频声波查看器官、组织或胎儿的医学检查
senses.example: She had an ultrasound at twelve weeks of pregnancy.
senses.exampleCN: 她怀孕十二周时做了一次超声波检查。
senses.why: Hospitals turned the imaging method into a routine examination, so the word now names the appointment itself.
senses.whyCN: 医院把这种成像手段变成常规检查，于是这个词从「技术」又变成了「检查这件事」，就像做一次 B 超。

senses.title: The picture produced
senses.definition: the grey image that a scanning machine displays, used to judge shape, size, and movement
senses.definitionCN: 扫描机器显示出来的灰色图像，用来判断形状、大小与运动
senses.example: The ultrasound showed a small dark spot on the liver.
senses.exampleCN: 超声图像显示肝脏上有一个小小的暗点。
senses.why: The output of a scan is a picture, and people often call the picture itself an ultrasound rather than saying sonogram.
senses.whyCN: 扫描的产出是一幅图，人们常直接说「超声图」，而不说 sonogram，于是这个词又多出一个指图像的义项。

intro.en: Ultrasound is a modern English compound of the Latin prefix ultra- (beyond) and the Latin noun sonus (sound).
intro.cn: ultrasound 是现代英语复合词，由拉丁语前缀 ultra-（超出）与拉丁语名词 sonus（声音）组合而成。

items.en: Ultra is a Latin preposition meaning beyond or on the far side.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ultra 是介词，意为「超出」「在……之外」。

items.en: Sonus means sound, audible noise, and it also gives sonar and sonic.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sonus 意为声音、可听见的响动，也是 sonar 与 sonic 的来源。

items.en: Ultrasonic appears in English for sound frequencies above hearing, with the ending -ic marking an adjective.
items.cn: 英语先出现 ultrasonic 一词，用 -ic 结尾作形容词，指高于听觉范围的频率。

items.en: The noun ultrasound is recorded in the early twentieth century as the scientific study of such high frequencies gathered pace.
items.cn: 二十世纪初，随着对高频声波的科学考察加快，名词 ultrasound 开始被记录使用。

items.en: Wartime work on echo detection and metal testing made ultrasound a practical tool.
items.cn: 战时围绕回声探测与金属探伤的研究，使超声波成为实用工具。

items.en: After the late 1950s medical scans spread, and ultrasound became the everyday word for a pregnancy check.
items.cn: 二十世纪五十年代末以后医学扫描普及，ultrasound 成了孕期检查的日常说法。

note.en: Ultrasound is built on the sound root son, so it is near ultrasonic and sonar, and in meaning it sits beside infrasound, echo, and the machine word scanner.
note.cn: ultrasound 建立在表示声音的词根 son 之上，与 ultrasonic、sonar 形近同源，语义上与 infrasound（次声）、echo（回声）以及指机器的 scanner 相邻。

entries.definition: relating to sound waves too high to be heard
entries.definitionCN: 超声的；指频率高于人耳上限的声波，与 ultrasound 同源

entries.definition: equipment that finds objects under water by means of sound echoes
entries.definitionCN: 声呐；靠声波回声探测水下目标，共享表示声音的 son- 词根

entries.definition: faster than the speed of sound
entries.definitionCN: 超音速的；指速度超过声音，只是前缀形近，与 ultrasound 词义不同，词源同样来自拉丁语 sonus

entries.definition: sound below the range of human hearing
entries.definitionCN: 次声；指频率低于人耳下限的声音，与 ultrasound 正好相反

entries.definition: a sound that bounces back from a surface and is heard again
entries.definitionCN: 回声；指碰到界面反射回来的声音，是超声成像依赖的现象

entries.definition: a device that examines something and produces an image of it
entries.definitionCN: 扫描仪；泛指探测并成像的机器，与义项 03 的设备义接近

normalIntro.en: Ultrasound glues together ultra (beyond) and sound, so the word itself says beyond sound, and almost every meaning follows from that one idea.
normalIntro.cn: ultrasound 把表示「超出」的 ultra 与 sound 直接拼在一起，字面就是「超出声音」，几乎全部义项都由这一个念头长出来。

normal.en: Split the word into ultra plus sound: sound pushed beyond what people can hear.
normal.cn: 拆成 ultra 加 sound：被推到人耳之外的声音。

normal.en: Ultrasonic is the adjective built from the same two parts with the ending -ic.
normal.cn: ultrasonic 是用同样两个部分加上 -ic 构成的形容词。

normal.en: Son- in sonar and sonic comes from the Latin word for sound, just as ultrasound does.
normal.cn: sonar 与 sonic 里的 son- 同样源自拉丁语的「声音」一词。

normal.en: An ultrasound scan uses echoes, very much like a bat locating a moth in the dark.
normal.cn: 超声波扫描靠回声工作，很像蝙蝠在黑暗中定位一只飞蛾。

normal.en: Medical English often shortens the test to a scan, while ultrasound is the formal name.
normal.cn: 医学英语里常把这项检查简称为 scan，而 ultrasound 是正式名称。

abstract.en: Picture a wave so high-pitched that it passes straight through your ear unheard.
abstract.cn: 想象一道音调高得从耳朵里穿过去却不被听见的波，就像超声本身。

abstract.en: Imagine shouting at a wall in the dark and drawing the room from the reply.
abstract.cn: 想象在黑暗里对墙喊一声，再根据回声把房间画出来，这就是回声成像。

abstract.en: See a grey screen where a tiny grey silhouette slowly turns and waves.
abstract.cn: 想象一块灰色屏幕，上面一个灰色小影子慢慢转身、挥手，那是探头。

examples.en: The ultrasound showed that the baby was developing normally.
examples.cn: 超声波检查显示胎儿发育正常。

examples.en: Dolphins use ultrasound to find fish in murky water.
examples.cn: 海豚用超声波在浑浊的水中寻找鱼群。

examples.en: The clinic has two ultrasound machines but only one trained technician.
examples.cn: 诊所里有两台超声设备，却只有一名受过训练的技师。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特拉桑德」——像喊到嗓子都沙哑了，声音却高到没人听得见，那就是超声；这是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ultra（超出、在……之外）+ 拉丁语 sonus（声音），合成 modern 英语词根 ultra- + son-，核心义「超出听觉范围的声波」。

sensesIntro.en: Ultrasound starts as the name of sound above hearing, then names the imaging method, the machine, the medical examination, and finally the picture on the screen.
sensesIntro.cn: ultrasound 先指高于听觉范围的声音，继而指成像方法、机器、医学检查，最后指屏幕上那幅图像。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a beam of sound too high to hear, thrown into the body and drawn back as a picture.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束高到听不见的声波射进身体，弹回来画成一幅图。

branches.en: The basic physics sense, sound above the hearing range.
branches.cn: 基础物理义：高于听觉范围的声波。

branches.en: The imaging method that listens to reflected waves.
branches.cn: 成像方法义：靠反射回来的波作图。

branches.en: The hardware that makes the technique possible.
branches.cn: 设备义：让这项技术得以实现的机器。

branches.en: The medical appointment where the method is used on a patient.
branches.cn: 医学检查义：医生在病人身上使用这项方法。

branches.en: A finished examination always ends with a picture that doctors read.
branches.cn: 检查做完总会留下图像供医生判读，两个义项首尾相连。

intro.en: Ultrasound is a compound of the Latin prefix ultra- and the Latin root son-, behind sonic, sonar, ultrasonic, and sonogram.
intro.cn: ultrasound 由拉丁语前缀 ultra- 与拉丁语词根 son- 复合而成，sonic、sonar、ultrasonic、sonogram 都围绕这个结构。

latinIntro.en: Latin ultra means beyond, and Latin sonus means sound; together they name sound that lies beyond hearing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ultra 意为「超出」，拉丁语 sonus 意为「声音」，合起来就是躺在听觉范围之外的声音。

items.example: The prefix ultra- marks a thing beyond a limit.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ultra- 表示超出某个界限。

items.example: The root son- appears in sonic and sonar.
items.exampleCN: 词根 son- 出现在 sonic 与 sonar 里。

items.example: Ultrasonic cleaning uses the same invisible waves.
items.exampleCN: 超声清洗用的就是同样的看不见的波。

items.example: Ultrasound is the compound itself.
items.exampleCN: ultrasound 就是那个复合词本身。

items.example: Ultrasonography names the medical method formally.
items.exampleCN: ultrasonography 是这项医学方法的正式名称。

items.example: The suffix -graphy appears in photography too.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -graphy 也出现在 photography 里。

items.example: The suffix -gram forms sonogram.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -gram 构成 sonogram。

items.example: A sonogram is the printout of the echoes.
items.exampleCN: sonogram 是回声打印出来的图。

items.meaningCN: 次声；低于听觉下限的声音
items.example: The prefix infra- marks the opposite side.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 infra- 标示相反的另一侧。

definition_zh: 一致同意；全体意见一致
definition_en: complete agreement among all the people in a group, so that everyone shares the same opinion
core_image: 一群人举手投票，手一只只举起来，全是同一个方向
scene: 委员会讨论新规定，最后所有人举起了手，没有一张反对票。The board reached unanimity before they approved the new rules.
sceneCN: 这里 unanimity 是「一致同意」（第 1 个义项：全体成员持相同意见）；句意：董事会一致同意后才通过了新规定。

derivatives.zh: 同词源形容词，由 un-（一个）与 animus（心智）加 -ous 构成，义为「全体一致的」
由 unanimous 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，义为「一致地」
由 unanimous 加名词词尾 -ness 构成，义为「全体一致的性质」
少见词，由 unanimity 与 -ist（人）组合，指主张全体合唱或全体一致的人

senses.title: Complete agreement in a group
senses.definition: the state in which every member of a group holds the same opinion
senses.definitionCN: 一个团体的每个成员都持相同意见的状态
senses.example: There was unanimity among the neighbours about closing the park gate at night.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们对夜间关闭公园大门这件事意见一致。
senses.why: Latin unus means one and animus means mind, so unanimity is literally a group with a single mind.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，animus 意为「心意」，所以 unanimity 字面上就是「一个心意」，一群人只剩一种想法。

senses.title: A formal vote with no opposition
senses.definition: the result of a vote in which every eligible member votes the same way
senses.definitionCN: 所有有表决权的人都投同一方向票的结果
senses.example: The committee reported unanimity on the spending plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会报告说，支出计划获得全票通过。
senses.why: In meetings the inner picture of one mind becomes an outer fact, counted vote by vote, and that is when the word sounds most legal.
senses.whyCN: 在会议里，「一个心意」这层内在想象变成了外在事实，要靠一张张选票数出来，所以这个词在正式表决的语境里最常用。

senses.title: Praise or comment that everyone shares
senses.definition: a state in which critics or observers all express the same judgement
senses.definitionCN: 评论者或观察者都作出相同判断的状态
senses.example: Critics greeted the novel with unanimity, which is rare for a first book.
senses.exampleCN: 评论界对这部小说众口一词，这对处女作来说很少见。
senses.why: The same one-mind idea stretches from decisions to opinions, so reviews, applause, and public reaction can also be unanimous.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「一个心意」的念头从决定延伸到看法，所以书评、掌声、公众反应也都能一致，此时指的不是投票而是评价。

intro.en: Unanimity comes from Latin unanimitas, which rests on unus (one) and animus (mind, spirit, soul).
intro.cn: unanimity 来自拉丁语 unanimitas，其根基是 unus（一）与 animus（心意、精神、魂），核心是「一颗心」。

items.en: Animus means mind, spirit, or courage, and it is different from anima, which means breath or soul.
items.cn: 拉丁语 animus 意为心意、精神、勇气，与表示呼吸、灵魂的 anima 是两个不同的词。

items.en: Unus means one, and it gives English uni-, unity, and union.
items.cn: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，是英语 uni-、unity、union 的共同来源。

items.en: Unanimus describes people who share one mind, and the abstract noun unanimitas names that shared state.
items.cn: 古典拉丁语里 unanimus 形容人们同心同德，抽象名词 unanimitas 则指这种同心状态。

items.en: Later Latin writers used unanimitas widely in legal and ecclesiastical writing, where votes and declarations were counted.
items.cn: 后世拉丁语作家在法律与教会文书中大量使用 unanimitas，那里正是要清表决票与声明的场合。

items.en: Unanimity enters English through the same Latin noun and is first used of agreement among church councils and assemblies.
items.cn: unanimity 经由同一个拉丁语名词进入英语，早期多用于指宗教会议与集会的全体一致。

items.en: Today it covers any complete agreement, from parliaments and juries to critics and family groups.
items.cn: 今天它指任何完全一致的情形，从议会、陪审团到评论界、家庭，都可以这么说。

note.en: Unanimity is the abstract noun beside unanimous, unanimously, and the Latin pair unus and animus; in meaning it sits close to consensus and agreement.
note.cn: unanimity 是与 unanimous、unanimously 并列的抽象名词，背后是拉丁语的 unus 与 animus 一对词；语义上紧邻 consensus 与 agreement。

entries.definition: agreed on by everyone in a group
entries.definitionCN: 全体一致的；与 unanimity 同词源的形容词

entries.definition: in a way that is agreed on by everyone
entries.definitionCN: 全体一致地；unanimous 加 -ly 构成的副词

entries.definition: a feeling of strong dislike, or in Latin the mind itself
entries.definitionCN: 敌意、反感；拉丁语原义为心意，anima 家族共享的词根来源，并非同义

entries.definition: general agreement reached by a whole group
entries.definitionCN: 共识；全体一般性的同意，可比 unanimity 略宽

entries.definition: the state of sharing the same opinion
entries.definitionCN: 同意；意见相同，是最中性的说法

entries.definition: a formal state of agreement or harmony
entries.definitionCN: 一致；正式协议或和睦状态，语气较正式

normalIntro.en: Unanimity is one mind made into a noun: uni- means one, anim means mind, and -ity turns the state into a name.
normalIntro.cn: unanimity 就是「一个心意」写成名词：uni- 是一，anim 是心意，-ity 把这个状态变成名词。

normal.en: Uni- means one and animus means mind, so unanimity is a group with one mind.
normal.cn: uni- 是一，animus 是心意，所以 unanimity 就是「同心」。

normal.en: The adjective is unanimous; the noun adds -ity, as unity comes from one.
normal.cn: 形容词是 unanimous，名词加 -ity，就像 unity 来自「一」。

normal.en: Compare animus and animal, which also carry the idea of a living spirit.
normal.cn: 对比 animus 与 animal，它们也带着「有生气的东西」这层意思。

normal.en: Unanimity is countable in reports, so you can speak of a rare unanimity.
normal.cn: 在报告里它能带冠词，可以说 a rare unanimity，所以它有复数形式。

normal.en: Consensus is broader; unanimity insists that no one at all objects.
normal.cn: consensus 更宽泛，unanimity 强调没有任何一个人反对。

abstract.en: Picture a forest of raised hands, all fingers pointing the same way.
abstract.cn: 想象一片举起的手，所有手指都指向同一个方向，这就是一致。

abstract.en: Imagine a choir where every voice sings the same note.
abstract.cn: 想象一个合唱团，每个人唱的都是同一个音，一种心意。

abstract.en: See a tally sheet where every box is ticked yes and none is blank.
abstract.cn: 想象一张计票表，每一格都打了勾，没有一个空白。

examples.en: The jury reached unanimity after only two hours.
examples.cn: 陪审团仅用两小时就达成一致。

examples.en: There was unanimity among economists about the short-term risk.
examples.cn: 经济学家们对短期风险看法一致。

examples.en: Complete unanimity is hard to achieve in a group of thirty.
examples.cn: 在三十人的群体里很难做到完全一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「you 拿那米提」——大家把同一把米提起来，谁也没少一颗，于是全体一致；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 unus（一）+ animus（心意、精神）+ 名词词尾 -itas（英语作 -ity），核心义「一个心意」，即全体持同一想法。

sensesIntro.en: Unanimity begins as the abstract state of one mind, hardens into a counted vote with no opposition, and widens to shared praise or shared judgement.
sensesIntro.cn: unanimity 先是「一个心意」的抽象状态，随后凝固为无人反对的全票表决，再扩展到众口一词的称赞或评判。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole group raising hands in one identical direction.
core.cn: 核心意象：一群人举手，所有的手都指向同一个方向。

branches.en: The basic state sense, everyone holding the same opinion.
branches.cn: 基础状态义：每个人都持相同意见。

branches.en: The legal sense where agreement is counted in a vote.
branches.cn: 表决义义项：用计票方式确认一致。

branches.en: The evaluative sense where critics or observers speak with one voice.
branches.cn: 评定义项：评论者或观察者众口一词。

branches.en: A group and a circle of critics both become one mind, one inside a meeting and one in public.
branches.cn: 团体与评论界都变成「一个心意」，一个在会议室里，一个在公众面前。

branches.en: A unanimous room is a state; a unanimous vote is the same state measured.
branches.cn: 全场的想法是状态，全票通过则是把这个状态量了出来。

intro.en: Unanimity is built from the Latin elements uni- (one), anim- (mind), and the noun suffix -ity, the same pattern behind unity and solidarity.
intro.cn: unanimity 由拉丁语成分 uni-（一）、anim-（心意）与名词词尾 -ity 构成，unity 与 solidarity 也走类似的路子。

latinIntro.en: Latin unus means one and animus means mind or spirit, so unanimitas names a body of people sharing one mind.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，animus 意为心意或精神，所以 unanimitas 指一群人共享一个心意。

items.example: The prefix uni- appears in uniform and unity.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 uni- 出现在 uniform 与 unity 里。

items.example: The root anim- also appears in animate.
items.exampleCN: 词根 anim- 也出现在 animate 里。

items.example: The suffix -ity forms the abstract noun.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ity 构成抽象名词。

items.example: Unanimous describes the group directly.
items.exampleCN: unanimous 直接形容这个群体。

items.example: Unanimously describes how a vote was taken.
items.exampleCN: unanimously 说明表决是怎样通过的。

items.example: Unanimity names the shared state.
items.exampleCN: unanimity 指那种共享的状态。

items.example: Unanimousness is a rare alternative noun.
items.exampleCN: unanimousness 是较少见的名词替代形式。

items.meaning: a person who favours all-in-one action
items.example: Unanimist is a rare noun in music writing.
items.exampleCN: unanimist 在音乐写作里偶尔出现，指主张全体一致者。

definition_zh: 全体一致的；一致同意的；全票的
definition_en: supported or agreed on by everyone in a group, with no one disagreeing
core_image: 一张圆桌上所有人同时点头，头低了又抬，动作整齐得像一个人
scene: 评审会上，几位评委看完作品，互相看了看，随后一起点头。The judges were unanimous in their praise of the young chef.
sceneCN: 这里 unanimous 是「全体一致的」（第 1 个义项：全体成员相同意见）；句意：评委们对这位年轻厨师的表现为一致赞扬。

pos.zh: 全体一致的；一致同意的；全票的

derivatives.zh: 由 unanimous 改 -ous 为 -ity 构成，义为「全体一致、一致同意」
由 unanimous 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，义为「一致地」
由 unanimous 加名词词尾 -ness 构成，义为「全体一致的性质」
法律用语，由 unanimous 与 consent（同意）组成，义为「全体一致同意」

senses.title: Shared by everyone in a group
senses.definition: expressing the same opinion as every other member of a group
senses.definitionCN: 与团体中每个其他成员持相同意见
senses.example: The staff were unanimous that the canteen should open later.
senses.exampleCN: 员工们一致认为食堂应该晚一点开门。
senses.why: Latin unus (one) plus animus (mind) gives a person or group of literally one mind, and -ous makes that a description.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 unus（一）加 animus（心意）就是「一个心意」，-ous 把它变形容词，所以是一群人脑子里的想法完全相同。

senses.title: Reached by a vote with no opposition
senses.definition: describing a decision or vote passed by every voter, with nobody against it
senses.definitionCN: 指决定或表决由全体投票人通过、无人反对
senses.example: The council made a unanimous decision to close the road on Sundays.
senses.exampleCN: 市议会一致决定周日封闭这条道路。
senses.why: When a count is taken, one mind becomes a measurable result, and the word then modifies the decision, the vote, or the verdict.
senses.whyCN: 一旦开始计票，「一个心意」就变成可量化的结果，于是这个词常去修饰决定、票数和裁决。

senses.title: An opinion voiced by all critics
senses.definition: used of a judgement or reaction that every critic or observer shares
senses.definitionCN: 形容所有评论者或观察者共享的判断或反应
senses.example: The film drew unanimous praise from reviewers in three countries.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片获得三国影评人的一致好评。
senses.why: The one-mind idea spreads from meetings to public opinion, where newspapers and judges of taste all say the same thing.
senses.whyCN: 「一个心意」从会议室蔓延到舆论，报纸和懂行的评论者说法完全相同，就是众口一词。

intro.en: Unanimous is a Latin loan whose two parts, unus (one) and animus (mind), still show through the spelling.
intro.cn: unanimous 是来自拉丁语的借词，拼写里仍能看出两个部分：unus（一）与 animus（心意）。

items.en: Animus means mind, spirit, or courage, and it is distinct from anima, breath or soul.
items.cn: 拉丁语 animus 意为心意、精神、勇气，与表示呼吸、灵魂的 anima 不同。

items.en: Unus means one; the adjective unanimus means of one mind.
items.cn: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，形容词 unanimus 意为同心同德。

items.en: Classical authors apply unanimus to allies, crowds, and voices that all move together.
items.cn: 古典作家用 unanimus 形容盟友、人群与声音步调完全一致。

items.en: Unanimous comes into English directly from Latin and is first used of assemblies and councils.
items.cn: unanimous 直接由拉丁语进入英语，早期多用于指集会与会议的全体一致。

items.en: With the growth of courts and committees, unanimous verdict and unanimous vote become fixed phrases.
items.cn: 随着法庭与委员会增多，unanimous verdict 与 unanimous vote 逐渐固定成搭配。

items.en: Today the word covers juries, panels, reviews, and any group that speaks with one voice.
items.cn: 今天这个词覆盖陪审团、评审团、评论界以及任何众口一词的群体。

note.en: Unanimous is the adjective next to unanimity and unanimously; in meaning it is close to united, of one mind, and consensus terms.
note.cn: unanimous 是与 unanimity、unanimously 相邻的形容词；语义上靠近 united、of one mind 以及围绕共识的说法。

entries.definition: the state of everyone thinking alike
entries.definitionCN: 全体一致；与 unanimous 同词源的名词

entries.definition: in a way that everyone agrees
entries.definitionCN: 全体一致地；由 unanimous 加 -ly 构成的副词

entries.definition: having a name that is not known
entries.definitionCN: 匿名的；只是拼写结尾相近，-onym 与 animus 词源不同

entries.definition: joined together and acting as one
entries.definitionCN: 团结的；联合成为一体，强调结合而非投票

entries.definition: in agreement with one another
entries.definitionCN: 一致的；彼此和谐，较正式少用

entries.definition: sharing the same opinion
entries.definitionCN: 想法一致的；短语形式，正是这个词的字面意

normalIntro.en: Unanimous says one mind in two pieces: uni- for one and anim- for mind, with -ous making it an adjective.
normalIntro.cn: unanimous 把「一个心意」写成两段：uni- 是一，anim- 是心意，-ous 让它变成形容词。

normal.en: Uni- means one, as in uniform and unique, and animus means mind.
normal.cn: uni- 表示一，如 uniform、unique；animus 表示心意。

normal.en: The noun is unanimity; the adverb is unanimously, which is even more common than the adjective.
normal.cn: 名词是 unanimity，副词是 unanimously，副词其实比形容词更常用。

normal.en: The usual pattern is a unanimous vote, a unanimous decision, or to be unanimous in something.
normal.cn: 常见搭配是 a unanimous vote、a unanimous decision，以及 be unanimous in 某方面。

normal.en: An anonymous ending only looks similar; the -onym part means name, not mind.
normal.cn: anonymous 的结尾只是看起来像，其中的 -onym 指名字，与心意无关。

normal.en: Compare consensus: a consensus may leave a few doubters, unanimity cannot.
normal.cn: 对比 consensus：共识可能留有少数疑问者，全体一致则不能有。

abstract.en: Picture a row of judges nodding together, no head turning to disagree.
abstract.cn: 想象一排评委一起点头，没有一个脑袋转向反对。

abstract.en: Imagine a show of hands where the whole room is a single forest of fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象一次举手，整个房间像一片整齐竖起的手指。

abstract.en: See an empty column on a tally sheet where no votes should be counted.
abstract.cn: 想象计票表上有一栏始终空白，那一栏本该记录反对票。

examples.en: The panel was unanimous in choosing the winning design.
examples.cn: 评审团一致选中了获奖设计。

examples.en: A unanimous vote of the board ended the debate.
examples.cn: 董事会的一致表决结束了这场争论。

examples.en: Doctors were nearly unanimous about the benefits of the vaccine.
examples.cn: 医生们对疫苗的好处几乎意见一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「优男你莫死」——大家一致认为这位优等男生不会出事，于是全票安心；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 unus（一）+ animus（心意、精神）+ 形容词词尾 -ous，核心义「一个心意的」，即全体一致。

sensesIntro.en: Unanimous begins as a description of one shared mind, then qualifies a vote that no one opposes, and finally extends to a judgement that every voice repeats.
sensesIntro.cn: unanimous 先是形容「一个心意」，随后修饰无人反对的表决，最后扩展到所有人都重复同一判断的情形。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole table nodding at the same instant, like one body.
core.cn: 核心意象：一桌人同时点头，整齐得像一个人。

branches.en: The basic descriptive sense, everyone sharing one opinion.
branches.cn: 基础描述义：每个人持同一意见。

branches.en: The voting sense, where agreement is counted and opposition is zero.
branches.cn: 表决义：把同意数出来，反对为零。

branches.en: The public sense, where critics and observers speak with one voice.
branches.cn: 公共义：评论者与观察者众口一词。

branches.en: A unanimous panel is the state; its unanimous decision is that state turned into an act.
branches.cn: 评审团的意见一致是状态，一致作出的决定是把状态变成行动。

branches.en: Both a passed vote and a shared review are forms of one voice sounding together.
branches.cn: 通过的表决与一致的评价，都是同一个声音在合响。

intro.en: Unanimous is assembled from Latin uni- (one), anim- (mind), and the adjective ending -ous; unanimity and unanimously build on the same base.
intro.cn: unanimous 由拉丁语 uni-（一）、anim-（心意）与形容词词尾 -ous 组装而成，unanimity 与 unanimously 建在同一个基础上。

latinIntro.en: Latin unus means one and animus means mind, so unanimus describes people who share a single mind.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，animus 意为心意，因此 unanimus 形容同心同德的人。

items.example: The prefix uni- also appears in unify.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 uni- 也出现在 unify 里。

items.example: The root anim- appears in animal and animate.
items.exampleCN: 词根 anim- 出现在 animal 与 animate 里。

items.example: The suffix -ous makes the word an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ous 把词变成形容词。

items.example: Unanimous is the base adjective.
items.exampleCN: unanimous 是基础形容词。

items.example: Unanimity swaps -ous for -ity.
items.exampleCN: unanimity 把 -ous 换成了 -ity。

items.example: Unanimously tells how something was agreed.
items.exampleCN: unanimously 说明是怎样通过一致的。

items.example: The un- in unanimous is not a negative prefix.
items.exampleCN: unanimous 里的 un- 并不是否定前缀，它是拉丁语 unus 的一部分。

items.example: Unanimousness is a rare abstract noun.
items.exampleCN: unanimousness 是少见的名词形式。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms unanimously.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 构成 unanimously。

definition_zh: 不可获得的；无法使用的；（人）没空的；联系不上的；售罄的
definition_en: not able to be obtained, used, reached, bought or talked to, often only for a limited time
core_image: 超市冷柜上贴着一张手写纸条，正对着空空的货架
scene: 超市冷柜里那排草莓酸奶刚被拿空，玻璃门上贴着一张手写纸条。Fresh milk is unavailable at the moment because the delivery lorry broke down.
sceneCN: 这里 unavailable 是「暂时无法获得、售罄」（第 1 个义项：某物暂时拿不到、买不到、用不上）；句意是送奶的货车坏了，眼下新鲜牛奶买不到。画面里贴着纸条的冷柜让这个否定显得很具体：东西本来就在那儿，只是此刻拿不到。

pos.zh: 形容词：不可获得的；无法使用的；没空的

collocations.zh: 暂时无法获得；暂时缺货
联系不上；无法接受采访评论
在你所在的地区不可用

forms.label: 比较级（用 more 构成）
最高级（用 most 构成）
肯定形式（去掉否定前缀）

derivatives.zh: 由该形容词加表示性质的名词尾构成，义为「不可获得性；缺货状态」
该词去掉否定前缀后的基础形容词，义为「可获得的；可用的；有空的」
由基础形容词加名词尾构成，义为「可用性；可获得性」；与该词构成的否定名词互为反义
整个词族的动词来源，义为「有助于；对……有用」；由「有用」引申出「能取得」

senses.title: Not to be had at the moment
senses.definition: not able to be obtained, bought or used just now, though it may be back later
senses.definitionCN: 眼下拿不到、买不到或用不上，但以后可能还会有
senses.example: Fresh bread is unavailable until the ovens are repaired.
senses.exampleCN: 烤箱修好之前，新鲜面包买不到。
senses.why: Available grew from avail, to be of worth or use, and the suffix -able says can be got at; un- simply blocks the getting.
senses.whyCN: available 来自 avail「有用、有价值」，后缀 -able 表示「可以……的」，否定前缀 un- 只是把这份「可以拿到」挡住，所以义为拿不到。

senses.title: Out of stock or sold out
senses.definition: not offered for sale because the shop, the warehouse or the website has none left
senses.definitionCN: 因为商店、仓库或网站已经卖完，所以不再供应
senses.example: The cinema lists that film as unavailable this week.
senses.exampleCN: 电影院把这周该片的场次标为售罄。
senses.why: The commercial sense narrows availability to stock on a shelf, so an empty shelf turns available into its exact negative.
senses.whyCN: 商业义把「可得」收窄到货架上有没有货，货架一空，available 就正好翻转成 unavailable。

senses.title: Switched off or out of reach
senses.definition: of a phone, a service or an online account, turned off, broken, or blocked so that it cannot be reached
senses.definitionCN: 指电话、服务或网络账号关机、出故障或被阻止，因此联系不上
senses.example: The line was unavailable all night during the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨那一夜线路一直不通。
senses.why: In modern use the thing that may be got at is a signal or a connection, and a dead network makes it unavailable.
senses.whyCN: 现代用法里「可以取得」的对象变成了信号或连接，网络一断它就不可得。

senses.title: Too busy to be met
senses.definition: of a person, not free to meet, talk or take on new work at a given time
senses.definitionCN: 指人在某段时间里腾不出身，无法见面、通话或接新任务
senses.example: The doctor is unavailable on Friday afternoons.
senses.exampleCN: 医生周五下午没有空。
senses.why: Available for people means free to be seen, so the negative simply says there is no free hour to be found.
senses.whyCN: available 用于人时表示「有空可见」，加上否定就只是说找不到一个可以腾出的空档。

senses.title: Not open to the public
senses.definition: of records, buildings, facilities or files, kept closed or restricted so that the public may not see or use them
senses.definitionCN: 指档案、建筑、设施或文件处于关闭或受限状态，公众不能查看或使用
senses.example: The council archive is unavailable to visitors while it is moved.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆搬迁期间不对外开放。
senses.why: Here the blocker is a rule or a move rather than empty stock, and availability means access; closed access is its negation.
senses.whyCN: 这里的障碍不是货架空了，而是规定或搬迁挡住了入口；可得就是可进入，入口一关便成否定。

senses.title: Withheld from comment
senses.definition: of an official, a spokesperson or an office, not reachable or not giving a statement when asked
senses.definitionCN: 指官员、发言人或不接受采访、联系不上的办事机构
senses.example: For three days the office was unavailable for comment.
senses.exampleCN: 有三天，那个部门都说联系不上、无法置评。
senses.why: Journalists need a source to be at the end of a phone, so the polite phrase unavailable for comment uses the same negative of getting hold of someone.
senses.whyCN: 记者需要电话那头有人接，于是委婉的不可采访、联系不上说法，用的还是同一个「够不着人」的否定。

senses.title: Missing from a data set
senses.definition: of a value, a record or a reading, absent or failing to be captured, so the result cannot include it
senses.definitionCN: 指某个数值、记录或读数缺失或没被采集到，结果无法把它算进去
senses.example: Half the readings were unavailable, so the average is unreliable.
senses.exampleCN: 一半读数缺失，所以平均值不可靠。
senses.why: Data is available when it can be produced, and a sensor that failed leaves its readings as information that cannot be had.
senses.whyCN: 数据能拿出来就叫可得，传感器一坏，它的读数就变成拿不到的信息。

senses.title: Not brought forward
senses.definition: in formal and legal writing, of evidence, a service or a request, not offered, supplied or made use of
senses.definitionCN: 正式或法律写作中，指证据、服务或请求没有被提出、提供或采用
senses.example: The witness said that the evidence had been unavailable at the first hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 证人称首次开庭时那份证据并未提供。
senses.why: To bring forward means to offer something for use, and a thing never offered is never made available to the court.
senses.whyCN: 「提出」就是把东西交给对方使用，从未提交的东西自然从未被提供出去，这是最正式的一层否定。

intro.en: Unavailable is an English-built negative: the Latin-rooted word available took the native prefix un-, so the word is old French and Latin in its base and Old English in its denial.
intro.cn: unavailable 是在英语内部加否定成分造出的词：底座 available 的根在拉丁语，而否定前缀 un- 是本土成分，因此一个词里叠着两种来源。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong or to be worth something, and the same root lies behind value, valid and valour.
items.cn: valere 意为有力量、有价值，value、valid、valour 都出自这个词根。

items.en: French built the verb avaler on valoir, and the sense of being worth or of use passed into English.
items.cn: 法语在 valoir 之上造出动词 avaler，「有价值、有用」的意思由此传入英语。

items.en: English borrowed the verb as avail, to be of use; the exact first English date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语借来动词 avail，意为「有用」；它在英语中确切的首见年代不确定。

items.en: The suffix -able turned the verb into an adjective, so available meant able to be of use to you.
items.cn: 后缀 -able 把动词变成形容词，available 最初意为「能为你所用的」。

items.en: The native negative prefix un- was added to form the opposite, and the word spread to people and to services.
items.cn: 加上本土否定前缀 un- 构成反义词，词义又扩展到人力和服务。

items.en: Telephones made unavailable for comment a fixed phrase, and software menus made it an everyday label.
items.cn: 电话让 unavailable for comment 变成固定说法，软件菜单又把它变成日常标签。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the worth root and other words that merely look alike; the near-meaning group gathers neighbours that all say something cannot be reached or used.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「有价值」词根构成的一族词，以及只是拼写相近却同源无关的词；近义组收同样表示够不着或不能用的相邻说法。

entries.definition: Able to be obtained, used or met; the positive word from which unavailable is formed by adding un-.
entries.definitionCN: 指可获得的、可用的或有空的，是本词去掉否定前缀后的肯定形式。

entries.definition: The noun for the state of being on hand or free, whose negative is unavailability.
entries.definitionCN: 指可用状态、可获得性，其否定名词是 unavailability。

entries.definition: To be of use or worth, the verb at the base of the whole family.
entries.definitionCN: 指有用、有价值，是整个词族底层的动词。

entries.definition: Too hard to put up with; it shares the un- plus -able shape but comes from bear, not from avail.
entries.definitionCN: 指难以忍受的；同样由否定前缀加 -able 构成，但词根是 bear，只是构词外形相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: Of value beyond price; it can look like a negative but means very great worth.
entries.definitionCN: 指价值连城的；外形像否定词，实际表示极高价值，注意不要与本词混淆。

entries.definition: Impossible to get at all, usually more absolute and more formal than unavailable.
entries.definitionCN: 指根本无法得到，通常比本词更绝对、更正式。

entries.definition: Hard or impossible to reach, especially of places where you must travel into the interior.
entries.definitionCN: 指难以或无法到达，多用于需要走进去的地方。

entries.definition: Of stock, all of it gone; a common and colloquial way to say that goods are unavailable.
entries.definitionCN: 指全部卖完，是口语中表达缺货的常见说法。

entries.definition: Of a telephone line, already in use by someone else; used mostly in British speech.
entries.definitionCN: 指电话线占线，主要用于英式说法。

entries.definition: Of a person or a hotel, having no free time or room left because everything is reserved.
entries.definitionCN: 指人或旅馆因预订已满而没有空档或空房。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real worth root, the native negative prefix and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的词根、本土否定前缀，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: The base available means can be got at, so the prefix un- flips it to cannot be got at.
normal.cn: 基础词 available 表示「可以拿到」，前缀 un- 一加就翻成「拿不到」。

normal.en: The same root gives value, valid and valour, all of them built on the idea of being worth something.
normal.cn: 同一词根还给出 value、valid 与 valour，它们都建在「有价值」这一念头上。

normal.en: In pharmacy adverts, sold out is the plain way of saying that a product is unavailable.
normal.cn: 在药品广告里，卖完售罄就是直白地说产品缺货。

normal.en: The fixed press phrase is unavailable for comment, said of an official who will not speak.
normal.cn: 新闻里的固定说法是「联系不上、无法置评」，用来说不肯开口的官员。

normal.en: Compare available: one letter pair un changes a welcome answer into a closed door.
normal.cn: 对比 available：只差一个否定前缀，欢迎的「可以」就变成紧闭的门。

abstract.en: Picture a label taped over a shelf: the goods exist somewhere behind the glass, yet the label says you cannot have them.
abstract.cn: 想象一张贴纸封在货架上：货也许还在玻璃后面，贴纸却说你现在拿不到。

abstract.en: Availability is a gap between a wish and a thing, and the word simply reports that the gap is open.
abstract.cn: 可得性是愿望与物之间的一道缝，这个词只是报告这道缝此刻张着。

abstract.en: A dead signal and a busy doctor are the same negative: for this moment, the door does not open.
abstract.cn: 断掉的信号和没空的医生是同一个否定：就在这一刻，门不开。

examples.en: The apartment is unavailable until the end of the month.
examples.cn: 这套公寓要到月底才能入住。

examples.en: Several seats were unavailable because of a fault in the booking system.
examples.cn: 由于订票系统故障，有几个座位无法预订。

examples.en: If you find me unavailable, leave a message and I will call back.
examples.cn: 如果找我没有空，请留言，我会回电。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「阿瓦伊勒不」——别人问「还有吗」，摊主一声「不」把话堵在货架前：买不到、没空；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 否定前缀 un-（不）+ available；available 由 avail + -able 构成，avail 经古法语 avaler 借自拉丁语 valere「有力量、有价值」，所以核心是「本来可以取用，但此刻被挡住」。否定前缀是本土成分，词根是拉丁成分，前半截与后半截来源不同；这个词在英语中形成的确切年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses take available, can be got at or used, and simply close the door: goods, stock, lines, people, facilities, comment, data and evidence each stand on the far side of that closed door.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都只是把「可以拿到、可以用上」这扇门关上：货物、库存、线路、人、设施、置评、数据与证据，各自站在门的那一边。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand-lettered note is stuck to a supermarket cooler, with one empty shelf behind the glass.
core.cn: 核心意象：超市冷柜的玻璃门上贴着一张手写纸条，柜里只剩一个空货架。

branches.en: THE SHELF: a thing that exists but cannot be had now, and a stock that has run dry.
branches.cn: 货架线：东西还在却此时拿不到，以及库存已经卖空。

branches.en: THE LINE: a connection or an account that is shut, so no message can arrive.
branches.cn: 线路线：连接或账号被关闭，消息送不进来。

branches.en: THE PERSON: someone too busy to be met, and an official who will not answer.
branches.cn: 人物线：忙得见不到的人，以及不肯回应的官员。

branches.en: THE DOOR: records and facilities kept shut by rule rather than by shortage.
branches.cn: 大门线：档案与设施因规定而不开，不是因为没有货。

branches.en: THE PAPER: a reading never captured and evidence never brought forward.
branches.cn: 纸面线：从未采到的读数，以及从未提交的证据。

intro.en: Unavailable is un- plus available, and available is -able plus avail, so two small pieces of building material sit in front of one Latin root.
intro.cn: unavailable 是 un- 加 available，available 又是 avail 加 -able；两小块构词材料叠在一个拉丁词根前面。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere, to be strong or worth something, is the recorded root; the Indo-European form behind it is only reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 valere「有力量、有价值」有文献记录，它背后更早的印欧语形式属于重构。

definition_zh: 没察觉的；不知道的；未意识到的；麻木于……的
definition_en: not knowing or not noticing something, especially something that is happening close by or that one should know about
core_image: 行人低头看手机，抬起头时雨已经停了，水洼还映着天光
scene: 雨已经停了，屋檐还在滴水，路过的行人低头看着手机，鞋尖踩进水洼才发现。He reached the platform unaware that the last train had gone.
sceneCN: 这里 unaware 是「没察觉、不知道」（第 1 个义项：未察觉身边正在发生的事）；句意是他走进车站，还不知道末班车已经开走。画面里踩着水洼才抬头的人，正是「知道晚了一步」的样子。

pos.zh: 形容词：没察觉的；不知道的；未意识到的
副词性旧用法：毫无觉察地（多见于 unawares）

forms.label: 比较级（用 more 构成）
